commands: set -e; git fetch --prune origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "dfd2ceb703d74fb667916073ccd4a0f75eb1c0e8"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo V67_BASELINE_OK

set -e; test -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; test -n "$serial"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d "\r")"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; echo DEVICE_OK=$serial:$model

set -e; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; adb -s "$serial" install -r -d app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$serial" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 5; echo INSTALL_AND_LAUNCH_OK

set -e; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; errors="$(adb -s "$serial" logcat -d -v brief -t 800 | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL|io\.blueeye.*FATAL' || true)"; test -z "$errors"; echo DEVICE_SMOKE_OK
